prompts.header: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background panorama for the Mordor dashboard shown in the reference. Reference is STYLE AND SUBJECT only, not an edit target. Create ONLY seamless scenic illustration, NO interface, words, frames, logos or boxes. Wide 3:1 panorama: dramatic black volcanic plain, ash mountains, fine distant lava rivers; Mount Doom erupting under red smoke near right-center, slender black Barad-dur tower with small fiery Eye at far right. Left half dark atmospheric ancient basalt architecture and subdued ash plain so real HTML cream text can sit over it. Painterly highly detailed premium fantasy game environment, black iron, charcoal and restrained orange-red embers, no bronze or green. No humans. Keep major subjects inside image, far enough away to show scale. Output wide landscape.
prompts.sidebar: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sidebar backdrop for the Mordor dashboard reference. Generate only a tall narrow architectural illustration, aspect 1:3, no interface, no letters, no emblems at top, no Eye, no menu, no boxes, no text. Weathered black volcanic stone slab with black iron jagged gothic buttress edges and sparse ember-orange fissures. Top 65 percent is quiet dark charcoal tactile stone, empty enough for real web controls overlaid. Lower 35 percent is a beautifully detailed vignette: black Barad-dur tower fragment on jagged obsidian, a hanging red ember lantern at right, lava fine fissures in rocks. Thin dark iron vertical side rails integrated. Top and bottom edges complete, no crop objects. Same premium painterly realism as reference, NO gold/bronze/dwarven motifs.
prompts.frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent modular UI panel frame master, square 1200x1200. Style reference Mordor dashboard. Create a SINGLE complete rectangular frame on TRUE transparent background, center fully transparent. Front-facing orthographic blackened iron and basalt, narrow elegant dark silver beveled rails with fine restrained ember-red seam and small ruby inset in each angular clipped gothic corner. OUTER frame within x80..1120 y80..1120, transparent exterior margin. Rail width about 35px, corner ornaments entirely within 150px of outer corners. Long middle stretches of all four rails must be quiet uniform straight rail for tiling; no center crest, no glyphs, no spiky center, no objects inside or outside. Crisp premium painterly materials, no copper/gold/bronze. Keep frame geometrically straight, no perspective.
prompts.icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production object atlas, 4 columns x 4 rows exactly, square 2048x2048. Style reference only Mordor dashboard. 16 separate isolated standalone objects centered in equal 512x512 cells with >=60px transparent space around each. No background, text, panels, plaques, boxes, arch frames behind objects, no cell boundaries. Premium painterly realistic small UI icons, front three-quarter view, black iron, dark silver, restrained ruby/ember accents. Row1 left-right: (1) parchment calendar with blank paper no numbers, (2) cozy round hobbit door in dark volcanic stone arch, (3) tied provision sack, (4) black raven perched on rock. Row2: (5) dark glass palantir orb on black iron stand with small ember reflection, (6) tightly rolled parchment tied red, (7) two crossed blacksmith tools, (8) mountain/compass insignia with red needle. Row3: (9) sun behind white clouds normal weather icon, (10) old black iron camera with red lens, (11) circular arrow in dark silver with ember edge, (12) dark silver cogwheel with ruby. Row4: (13) large fiery Eye slit pupil inside an elegant black iron jagged oval crest matching top-left of reference, (14) smaller fiery Eye with understated black iron prongs as a standalone footer emblem, (15) dark gothic tower for war room, (16) small black iron treasure chest with few gold coins. Exact grid; no object crossing cells. Real transparent alpha.
prompts.scroll: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square transparent production parchment scroll background 1280x1280. Style reference Mordor dashboard. A single large OPEN vertical ivory aged parchment scroll, face-on orthographic, NO WORDS, NO ICONS, NO WRITING, no interface. Complete horizontal physical parchment rollers at TOP and BOTTOM with black iron gothic end caps, dark silver detailing and a small red ruby on each end, no gold or bronze. Outer object occupies x48..1232 and y170..1110, roll centers y220 and y1060; paper body x128..1152 y250..1030. Large quiet pale warm ivory reading field, very subtle ash fibers and softly worn paper edge. Rollers are roughly 75px high and not oversized; tips extend beyond paper. Background and outside outline true transparent, no drop shadow plate, no ornamental rectangular frame, no dark background. Premium painterly game UI illustration. Generous transparent border with object fully in frame.
prompts.buttons: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent production button state atlas for a Mordor fantasy web dashboard. 3 columns x 2 rows exact equal cells on landscape canvas 1536x1024. Each cell contains ONE horizontal 430x130px unlabelled physical button centered with generous fully transparent gutters, no letters or glyphs, no icons, no UI mockup. Six states read left-right: top row normal black iron with dark red enamel/ash inset and thin silver bevel; hover with brighter ember edge; pressed with deep red subtle inset glow. Bottom row secondary slate with silver edge; secondary hover brighter silver; disabled muted charcoal with no glow. Long center quiet flat texture for HTML text. Clipped chamfered corners, narrow polished iron rails, subtle red enamel not bronze, understated ruby pin at corners optional small. All six same proportions. True transparent background and cell gutters. Premium painterly detail matching reference dark red metal controls.
prompts.hearth: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent production hearth states atlas, landscape 1536x1024 arranged THREE columns in one row, exact equal cells width512, each isolated centered with generous transparent margins. Same substantial black basalt arched fireplace repeated in 3 states, small black iron grate, few stacked logs, weathered dark ash stone, no words, no backgrounds/panels/numerals/temperatures. Left idle: unlit cold logs with absolutely no flames/glow, neutral dark interior, realistic. Center heating: warm orange natural flames glowing within grate, stone exterior same design. Right cooling: unlit fireplace with subtle cool blue ambient breeze glow inside, no flames. Premium painterly realism matching Mordor reference. Objects fully inside each cell and not touching neighbors. True transparent alpha. Hearth height approx 420px centered vertically.
